inputs.declared_question: How can a reader begin a source-grounded conversation with Cyberdelic OS without reading the entire archive first, while preserving disclosure, finite attention, and the boundary between external AI context and local Library search?

cartographer.inference: The immediate gap is findability of an existing instrument, not evidence for a new external neighbour or a necessary new manifest edge.
cartographer.uncertainty: The instrument specifies conduct but does not establish whether any chosen AI can browse, access memory, follow the prompt, or protect a conversation.

cartographer.no_proposal_reason: The inbox is empty and the bounded question is directly answered by an existing published instrument. Its declared related works provide enough orientation without external discovery or another proposal.

decisions.decision: Keep external AI conversation distinct from the site's deterministic, non-personalized three-work aperture. Do not promise model memory, browsing, or external-service privacy.
The instrument's declared I-002 and A-004 references may support contextual catalog placements, but no ratified edge or new implementation claim is warranted.
Leave the manifest and three-item Attending arrangement unchanged. Do not create a dated relational tending page for a catalog-only improvement.

evidence.locator: But interpretation must not disguise itself as fact.
Disclosure contract; Privacy boundary; The website does not receive the resulting conversation.
One shared catalog can support many routes through it without privately personalizing the underlying works.
Every reader enters the same public catalog and vocabulary.
A shareable URL can carry an inquiry without carrying a personal profile.
Every composed journey is finite.; No agent silently inherits a private archive.

gardener.decision_reason: The bounded cross-form reading supports the present distinctions between unchanged works, proposed placements, and external conversation. Cataloging can address the gap without changing relational claims or lifecycle states.

decisions.decision: Add one source-grounded record so a person searching for an AI reading companion, a portable prompt, or a conversation with the archive can find The Personal Aperture without knowing its title.
Retain model-proposed status and explicitly distinguish the instrument's requirements from guarantees about a visitor's chosen AI.

librarian.decision_reason: I-004 is already public but absent from the cumulative catalog. Its exact text supports one useful search record. Existing records remain intact.
